about: EVO Cabinet v2 switcher = the FO full-flow header instance switcher 1:1 (cab2-hero-v1, 2026-11-18, product owner). a = the reference (trigger: Cabinet EVO sm-01s; panel parts: FO fo-01s), b = v2 cab2-s06 (SRL Global Trader = the fo-01s subject, header switcher open). Content-dependent sizes (number of roles, page position of the header) are ignored.
